event.description: Share only corresponding LayerNorm biases across depth
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 2,128 parameters at 99.140000%, a +0.140000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 3 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted in-family result is attempt-0029, full attention/feed-forward sharing at 2,144 parameters and 99.14%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0033, which shared both LayerNorm scales and biases and peaked at 77.55% internal validation. Hypothesis: depth-specific normalization scale is necessary but additive offsets are less expressive and can be shared; tying only corresponding ln1 and ln2 bias vectors while retaining separate scale vectors yields 2,096 parameters. This is more informative than the nearest untested scale-only tie because the earlier successful deletion of the final LayerNorm bias suggests bias is the lower-risk affine component, while the full-affine failure establishes that both components cannot be tied together.
